name: Camping Ambach am See
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Camping Ambach am See is located directly on the shore of a lake in Tirol. The facility includes pitches for caravans, motorhomes, and tents. The sanitary facilities are in very good condition, and a private stretch of beach is available to guests. The lake is ideal for swimming and water sports. Marked hiking trails run through the surrounding area, and an on-site restaurant provides dining.
